    log_scale_similarity_threshold=0.1):
    if num1 == num2:
        return 0

        dist = logarithmic_distance(num1, num2)
        if dist < log_scale_similarity_threshold:

        return min(1, dist)

def _numpy_div(a, b, replace_inf_with=1):
    with np.errstate(divide='ignore', invalid='ignore'):
        result = np.where(b != 0, a / b, replace_inf_with)
    return result

def _get_numpy_array_distance(num1, num2, max_=1, use_log_scale=False,
    log_scale_similarity_threshold=0.1):
    if use_log_scale:
        log_num1 = numpy_apply_log_keep_sign(num1)
        log_num2 = numpy_apply_log_keep_sign(num2)
        dist = np.abs(log_num1 - log_num2)
        result = np.where(dist < log_scale_similarity_threshold, 0, np.minimum(1, dist))
        return result
    num1 = num1.astype(float)
    num2 = num2.astype(float)
    diff = np.abs(num1 - num2)
    max_val = np.maximum(np.abs(num1), np.abs(num2))
    distance = _numpy_div(diff, diff + max_val, replace_inf_with=1)
    equal_mask = num1 == num2
    distance = np.where(equal_mask, 0, distance)
    return np.minimum(max_, distance)
